summary: Write θ through the theta descent of the kernel; the descent is equivariant, and the Weil representation at k acts on V through the reduction s.

steps.claim: By theta_eq_smul_star_lift_swap, O.θ Ξ is a fixed scalar times the conjugate of the descent of conj(F_Ξ) through the swapped kernel, and the right side is the same with formAction s Ξ (s = reduction of k, hk); it suffices to compare the two descents.

The descent through the kernel is equivariant: translating its argument by (1, k) amounts to acting by k in the Weil representation on the kernel (lift_equivariant, the kernel's algebraic coefficient being automorphic); the finite Weil representation of k on the integrated kernel is computed by pairWeil_upsilon: it acts through the reductions s at the chosen places (reduceFamily_liftResidue).
steps.lean:
erw [O.pairThetaKernel.swap.lift_equivariant (isAutomorphic_algFormCoeff Ξ.1).conj, map_smul,
    pairWeil_integrated_fin O.W, O.pairWeil_upsilon k _ 1 (reduceFamily_liftResidue _)]

steps.claim: Unfolding the lift (Space.lift) and the action of s on the coefficients of Ξ (algFormCoeff_algFormRep), the two sides agree up to rearranging products of inverses (ac_rfl).
steps.lean:
simp [Space.lift, ← algFormCoeff_algFormRep, ← Finset.prod_inv_distrib, ← inv_apply_eq_inv',
    ← star_apply']
  ac_rfl
